/thod pa'i mchod yon snod du ni/ /zhal du mtshon cha nges par sbyar/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa las gnyis su med pa'i gnas dang dus ma yin par 'chi ba bslu ba'i cho ga'i le'u ste sum cu rtsa lnga pa'o// //de nas phyag rgya mchod chen dang / /sngags kyi dgod pa rab tu grags/ /phyag rgya'i mchod pa 'di dag gis/ /myur du 'grub par the tshom med/ /mtshan ma gnyis la sngags sbyor bas/ /mkha' 'gro dpa' bo gnyis med pa'i/ /padma'i 'od ni dri med pa/ /rnal 'byor ma la mkhas pas mchod/ /phyag rgya gnon pa'i las rnams ni/ /de bzhin mtshon cha nyid dang sbyar/ /sngags pas mkha' 'gro ma sbyor la/ /snying po rnams kyis de bzhin bya/ /bsrub pa mkha' 'gro blo ldan ma/ /dag pa'i lus kyis de bzhin bya/ /dpa' bo mchod pa'i cho ga shes/ /las ni 'bad pa nyid kyis bya/ /rnam dbye rang dgar sngags pa ni/ /phyin ci log tu nges par sbyar/ /tshar gcad pa dang phan gdags phyir/ /las kyi dngos po rnam par bsgom/ /de nyid dbye bas phye nas ni/ /rtsa yi lam du sbyar bar bya/ /sbyor ba rab tu sgrub rnams la/ /'di yis rab tu bsgrub bya ste/ /lha dang lha min rnams dang ni/ /mi dang bcas pa myur 'grub 'gyur/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa las de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dang las kyi cho ga'i le'u ste sum cu rtsa drug pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /gzugs ni gnon pa'i cho ga ste/ /phan tshun sbyor ba'i gsang sngags ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang gcig tu sbyar/ /zos nas mid pa'i rjes la ni/ /bzlas pa'i mthar ni skyug par bya/ /mtshan mo bdun ni rdzogs pa dang / /bza' ba btung ba dag la sbyar/ /'di yis ji srid 'tsho yi bar/ /dbang du 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /ser skya'i mar ni 'thungs nas su/ /de nas bzlas mthar skyug par bya/ /de yis rang gi gdong bkrus nas/ /gal te rtag tu khros gyur pa/ /mthong ba tsam gyis dbang du 'gyur/

/til mar sa lu btags pa dang / /ldan pas lus ni bskus 'gyur zhing / /snum khur sngags pas byas nas ni/ /bza' ba la ni rab tu sbyar/ /gal te las ni ma btang na/ /ji srid 'tsho bar dbang du 'gyur/ /til nag dag ni zos nas su/ /ske tsher bcas pa skyugs pa dang / /ru rta dag dang ldan par ni/ /lag skyes bshang lam 'byung srin bu/ /rang gi khrag dang brtags nas ni/ /swa shug kra ni nyid dag dang / /bza' btung mig sman gos la ni/ /byug pa nyid du rab tu sbyar/ /'di yis ji srid 'tsho yi bar/ /dbang du 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /ba glang sha bsreg sbyin bsreg dang / /khrag gis bskus nas lha rnams ni/ /de yi mod la dbang 'gyur ba'am/ /gal te ma 'ongs 'chi bar 'gyur/ /sha nyid de yi mdun du 'am/ /bsgoms nas mkhas pas sbyin sreg bya/ /sbyin sreg mthar ni gtor ma bya/ /khams gsum skad cig gis 'gugs 'gyur/ /mtshan bdun gyis ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /'jig rten gsum na rnyed dka' ba'i/ /dam tshig spyod pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /rtag tu rang sngags sbas pa yin/ /rab tu 'bad de gsang bar bya/ /sbas don rnyed par mi 'gyur zhing / /skal ba dman pas 'grub mi 'gyur/ /bsod nams chung ba'i sgrub pos kyang / /nga mnyes byas pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa las nang gi bdag nyid kyi dbang du bya ba'i khyad par du bya ba'i le'u ste sum cu rtsa bdun pa'o// //de nas brda rnams mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /lus kyi mtshan nyid gang yin dang / /dpa' bo'i yan lag dbye ba ni/ /de bzhin du ni bshad par bya/ /dpa' bo'i dbang phyug mi bri zhing / /gang gi thad du'ang mi gdon no/ /g.yon pa'i kun spyod legs sbas pa/ /gsang ba'i mtshan nyid mkha' 'gro yi/ /sngags ni bag med pas 'don na/ /de la nga ni mi lta ste/ /mkha' 'gro stong phrag du ma yis/ /ngan pa'i bdag nyid can de za/ /dam tshig 'dzoms zhing ngan spyod pa/ /bram ze gsod par the tshom med/

/sdig spyod rmongs pa'i bdag nyid can/ /bslus 'gyur ngan pa'i bdag nyid de/ /mkha' 'gro ma yis zos gyur kyang / /de la nga ni skyob mi byed/ /gsang ba pa yi nang na ni/ /sgrub po de ni phyugs dang 'dra/ /bla ma la 'khus dam tshig nyams/ /mtho ris 'jig rten las de ltung / /he ru ka dpal 'jigs sngags blta/ /gang zhig bsrung bar byed pa ni/ /mkha' gro mar bcas dge bsdong dang / /de la nga ni phan 'dogs so/ /bla mas kyang ni dgongs pa ste/ /gsang bar byed tshe sgrub pa po/ /mkha' 'gro ma la rtag dga' ba/ /de la dngos grub 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sgrub pa po ni dpang nyid 'gyur/ /khams gsum mkha' la rgyu ba'i bdag /sgrub po dpa' bo nyid 'dod pa/ /thams cad du ni mchod par 'gyur/ /de ni rnal 'byor la 'jug dga'/ /yang dag sbyin pa'ang rig par 'gyur/ /he ru ka yi brtul zhugs 'dzin/ /slob dpon dpa' bo mthong gyur na/ /sgrub pa pos ni sngags 'di dag /mthong zhing mthong zhing kun du dga'/ /rtsa ba'i sngags kyi gsang sngags mchog /dpa' bo yi ge bdun pa ni/ /'dzin par gang zhig byed pa ni/ /oṃ dang hūm̐ gis khyad par dbye/ /de rnams 'bad de phyag bya zhing / /sangs rgyas thams cad la sogs mchod/ /rtag tu dpa' bo chen po dang / /rol par ldan par the tshom med/ /de yi thugs kha nas phag mo/ /dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma/ /pho nya rnams dang lhan cig bcas/ /de yis gang zhig legs skyes pa/ /srog chags bsod nams mthong ba yin/ /chu bo rgya mtsho rdzing bu dang / /ri bo dang ni bzhi mdo dang / /lteng ka dang ni khron pa dang / /khang stong dang ni lam srang dang / /thams cad du ni mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu zhen par lta la gnas/ /'jigs pa chen po'i dur khrod dang / /mkha' spyod de bzhin sa 'og dang / /ro langs kyi ni du ma zhig /'jigs pa'i gzugs dang stobs chen pos/ /de dang lhan cig dpa' bo che/ /ci bde bar ni rol par mdzad/

/ri sul tshang tshing gsang ba dang / /gsang ba'i mi mo rnal 'byor ma/ /phyogs ni de dang de dag tu/ /sgrub pa po dang sa steng rol/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa las rnal 'byor ma'i sa dang gsang ba'i dpa' bo sngags kyi cho ga'i le'u ste sum cu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //de nas grub pa'i rnal 'byor che/ /sngags ni rnam pa brgyad po dgod/ /de nas 'di la yang dag mthong / /gsol bar 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /'jigs pa'i sgra ni rnam mang po/ /mi bzad mkha' 'gro 'jigs byed pa/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i dpa' bo ni/ /skrag cing rnam par 'byer bar byed/ /gal te dpa' bo mi 'jigs na/ /lag pa g.yon pas bzung nas ni/ /rang gi gnas su khyer bar byed/ /mi rnams mkha' 'gro de dag dang / /rtag tu mngon par rtse byed de/ /bde ba can gyi gnas 'drar 'gyur/ /he ru ka dpal gnas 'dod pas/ /mkha' la 'gro ba'i gnas su khyer/ /sgrub pa po ni sngags lus can/ /'khor ba'i rga dang skye ba med/ /'gro ba thams cad sdud par 'gyur/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa las ha ha zhes rgod pa'i le'u ste sum cu rtsa dgu pa'o// //de nas da ni bshad bya ba/ /gang gis mi rnams dbang du 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor sngags kyi cho gar gnas/ /sa la gnas pa gang yin pa/ /dpa' bo bzlas pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /sgron ma myos byed bcas pa dang / /nya yi sha dang ldan par ni/ /dpa' dbang gnas skabs thams cad du/ /nyi ma bdun gyis sgrub byed pa/ /mtshan mo sbyin sreg byed la gzhol/ /dngos grub rgya chen gsol bar 'gyur/ /brgya dang rtsa brgyad ldan nyid kyis/ /thun gsum du ni sgrub byed na/ /rgyal po dpung dang bcas pa ni/ /zhag bdun gyis ni dbang du 'gyur/ /phyed kyis dpa' bo chen po ste/ /de yi phyed kyis blon po 'o/ /rgyal phran la ni sum cu gnyis/ /bsreg pa'i rim gyis sbyin sreg bya/ /nyi shu bram ze nyid la ni/ /nyi ma bdun gyi sbyin sreg bya/

/de bzhin rgyal rigs dag la bdun/ /sbyin sreg lnga po rje rigs la/ /dmangs rigs la ni sbyin sreg gsum/ /tha ma la ni sbyin sreg gcig /de ltar dpa' bo rigs rim gyis/ /zla ba gcig nas yang dag spyad/ /sngags dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa pos/ /'gro ba thams cad dgug par bya/ /dpa' bo cho ga 'di yis ni/ /'dod pa bsten na 'grub par 'gyur/ /sa steng 'dod pa'i dbang phyug bzhin/ /dpal ldan skal ba bzang por 'gyur/ /sgrub po mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis/ /yid 'ong 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa las rigs lnga po dbang du bya ba dang phyag rgya chen po bsten pa'i le'u ste bzhi bcu pa'o// //de nas las kyi rab mchog ni/ /gang gis shes na sgrub pa pos/ /dbang dang dgug dang dbye ba dang / /bsad dang bskrad pa la sogs dang / /rmugs dang rengs par bya ba dang / /rmongs dang de bzhin phur bus gdab/ /tshig 'phrog lkugs par 'gyur ba dang / /'on dang de bzhin long ba dang / /ma ning nyid du bya ba dang / /gzugs ni yongs su brje ba ste/ /las chen bcu gnyis 'di dag ni/ /dngos grub sgrub pa po la ni/ /dran pas 'grub 'gyur gdon mi za/ /shar dang byang gi gnas la sogs/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni thams cad dang / /ye shes ldan pa'i rang skye gnas/ /yul dang yul du mngon par skyes/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor gtso mo ste/ /de ni mkha' 'gro ma rnams bshad/ /ku lu ta dang dgon pa dang / /sin dhu'i yul dang grong khyer dang / /gser gyi gling dang sau rāṣṭa/ /de bzhin khyim gyi lha dang ni/ /yi dwags grong dang kha ba'i gnas/ /kan tsi lam pā ka yi yul/ /ka liṅka dang ko sa la/ /tri sha kun ne o ṭe dang / /kā ma ru pa mā la be/ /lha mo'i mkhar dang rā mi dbang / /go ta ba ri ar bu ta/ /u rgyan dzā la na dha ra dang / /pu lā li ra ma ya la sogs/ /yul 'di dag gi bu mo gang / /dpa' bo gnyis med rnal 'byor ma/

/de kun 'dod pa'i gzugs can te/ /yid kyi shugs kyis 'jug pa yin/ /rnal 'byor ma drug ku lu ta/ /mya ngam yul na ma mo rnams/ /sin dhu nyid du lā ma ste/ /rigs kyi gtso mo na ga rar/ /lam pa dang ni sau raṣṭa/ /rigs kyi lha mo rnams yin te/ /yi dwags grong du nag chen mo/ /mkha' 'gro mar bcas ru pi ni/ /kha ba'i ri dang kan tsi dang / /pan tsa la yi yul dag dang / /khyim gyi lha mo ka ling kar/ /brtul zhugs 'dzin pa rnams yin no/ /ko sa lar ni sha za ba/ /yi dwags grong du gyur pa ru/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro sdom dbang phyug /tri sha ku ne khaṇḍa ro hā/ /de bzhin pu li ra ma la/ /gser gling sme sha can bud med/ /stong phrag nyi shu rtsa gcig yin/ /de las lhag pa ji snyed pa/ /dpal ldan he ru ka yi ni/ /'khor lo rnal 'byor ma yin no/ /shrī he ru ka'i srub pa che/ /de yi dkyil 'khor gtso mo yin/ /mkha' 'gro nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'dis/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'jig rten gsum/ /'gro ba thams cad 'di yis khyab/ /mkha' 'gro ma 'di'i dam tshig ni/ /sprul pa'i bsgom pa nyid yin te/ /bsam gtan la sogs gang ci'ang rung / /sa steng na ni rdzogs 'gyur ro/ /sngags pas rtag tu mnyam bzhag pas/ /mtshan mo nam mkha'i gos can bya/ /skyes pa'am gal te g.yon pa kun/ /rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bo dges/ /phyag rgya gar gyis mchod pa yis/ /rang 'byung rtag tu mchod na ni/ /ma lus lus pa med 'grub cing / g.yon pa'i mchod la rab tu 'jug /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa las yi ge nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dgod pa'i cho ga'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa'o// //de nas dpa' bo me tog chu/ /'thungs nas sngags 'di rjes dran bya/ /phyag rgya lhan cig sgrub pa pos/ /mtshan mo rtag tu sha bza' bya/ /sngags gsum bya ba 'di nyid kyis/ /grub pa'i bde ba thob par 'gyur/ /'thung dang de bzhin sbyin pa dang /

/thog ma tha ma dbus med pa/ /'khor lo bsgyur ba'ang de bzhin no/ /reg dang lhan cig gtso mo che/ /bden par tshangs par spyod pa dang / /thog mtha' bzhad pa'i phyag rgya bya/ /lta ba'i snyems pa grags ldan pa/ /mtshan mo'am de bzhin nyin mo ni/ /'dis ni bzhad pa dag tu bya/ /gzugs dang las kyi gsang ba gang / /ji ltar gnas pa dpa' bo nyon/ /rtag tu de yi mchi ma 'byung / /dad pas de yi ba spu ldang / /rdo rje la ni 'gom mi byed/ /de bzhin phyogs gos gyur pa mchod/ /g.yon pa'i dbang phyug thams cad kyi/ /'di ni phyag rgya'i tshogs kyi rim/ /dbugs 'byin bskyod dang rgod pa dang / /sgeg dang gar gyi ngo mtshar dang / /sna tshogs mdun du byas nas ni/ /phyag rgya sngags ni rjes dran bya/ /ha ha he he rnam pa brgyad/ /rgod dang sna tshogs dbang mchog dga'/ /ha ha'i rnam pa nye bar brtag /ngu bar byed pa rtag tu bsngags/ /de nyid kyis de dgar 'gyur zhing / /sngags dang bsam gtan legs sbyor ba/ /gtso mo rnams dang dpa' bo yi/ /spu ldang lhan cig 'byung bde ba/ /rdo rje bgom par mi bya ba/ /g.yon pas yongs su brtag pa yin/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa las mkha' gro ma'i gzugs yongs su brje ba dang / rgod pa'i sngags kyi cho ga'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //de nas gzigs pa bshad bya ste/ /dpa' bo dang ni gnyis med mi/ /gnas kyi dbye ba'i cho ga shes/ /bsgom la rtag tu mngon dga' ba'o/ /lam gyi bzhi mdo'am khyim dag gam/ /dpa' bo'i gnas kyi ri bor ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dam tshig gnas/ /ring po nas kyang gzigs par 'gyur na/ /phyag rgya gcer bur mchod pa yi/ /las nyid kyis ni yongs su grol/ /gos gzhan dag gis bkab nas ni/ /'dod pa rnams kyis reg mi bya/ /de bzhin skra ni grol 'gyur ba/ /las rnams thams cad brtsams pa la/ /rtsa ba'i sngags dang de bzhin sdigs/ /phyogs bcing bar ni 'jug pa dang /

/lha dang lha min tshogs kyis kyang / /ma mthong bar ni mchod par gyis/ /snyim par me tog gis bkang ste/ /mkha' la spyod la gyen du 'thor/ /me tog dag ni sa gzhi la/ /gal te ltung bar ma gyur na/ /de nyid du ni mi snang 'gyur/ /gnas kyi khyad par la gnas na/ /mkha' la 'gro bar stong phrag ni/ /gnas la dbang ni byed par 'gyur/ /ngag gi dbang phyug ma rnams dang / /gsung gi dbang phyug 'gugs par 'gyur/ /lha dang lha mo'i gtam shes shing / /sa 'og la sogs gang yod dang / /skar ma rgyu bar shes par 'gyur/ /yul yul de bzhin dgon pa dang / /grong khyer dang ni bzhi mdo dang / /shing gcig dang ni dpa' bo'i khyim/ /ri rtse dang ni mtshan drung du/ /rtag tu snying po nye snying 'don/ /lha dang mi yis mthong mi 'gyur/ /de bas yul phyogs 'di dag tu/ /sgrub pa po ni rtag tu gnas/ /shing rtser kha dog dmar bsams nas/ /yi ge bdun gyi bdag nyid ni/ /mi phyed par 'gyur pham par ni/ /sa 'dzin rnams kyang gzhan du min/ /bdag gi lus la rnam dgod de/ /sa la ku sha'i stan du nyal/ /yi ge bdun gyi bdag nyid gnas/ /brgya rtsa brgyad ni nyid du bzlas/ /rmi lam du ni bya ba kun/ /yid la 'dod pa ston par 'gyur/ /dus min 'chi dang bcom dang nyams/ /bya ba kun tu gang gyur pa/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gzhan dang gzhan/ /thams cad rmi lam dag tu ston/ /de bzhin sngags bzlas ral gri chu/ /mthe bong mar me me long dang / /sngags bzlas nyid rtag rnal 'byor pa/ /pra se na ni 'bebs par byed/ /bsgoms dang lan bdun bzlas bkod pas/ /dge dang mi dge ston par 'gyur/ /de nas dpa' bo yi ge bdun/ /sngags dgod pa yi dbye ba nyid/ /nyi ma'i dbus su bsams nas ni/ /stong gi bar du bzlas nas su/ /shel gyi rnam pa lta bu ni/ /nad kyis gdungs pa blta bar bya/ /mthe bong tsam gyis skad cig gis/ /nad rnams sel bar the tshom med/

/nad las rnam par grol gyur na/ /ston ka yi ni zla 'dra ba/ /zla ba'i dbus su rnam dgod cing / /lag pa g.yon par 'khor lo byed/ /yi ge shel gyi mdog ltar snang / /gzugs lnga ru ni blta bar bya/ /nad rnams kun la dgod par bya/ /rims dang gdon dang brjed byed dang / /gzer sogs kun dang mdze can dang / /dug gis zin pa'i nad rnams dang / /gang gi nad kyi sdug bsngal ba/ /zla gzugs yi ge bsams nas ni/ /phyogs bcur rnam par 'byer bar 'gyur/ /mtshan mo gsang ba la gnas te/ /go maṃ sa ni mngar gsum brtag /yig bdun gsang sngags shes pa dang / /stong rtsa brgyad du sbyin sreg byas/ /sngags pas nang par dus su ni/ /gser srang stong ni rnyed par 'gyur/ /sbyin sreg stong phrag bcu yis ni/ /yul 'khor dam pa rnyed par 'gyur/ /yang na gsang sngags rgyal po ni/ /gnas ni gang du bsams pa dag /de dang der ni de yi tshe/ /skye bar 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /dkar po yis ni zhi bar 'gyur/ /nag pos skad cig dag gis gsod/ /dmar pos dbang du 'gyur ba ste/ /'phral du nges par 'gugs par 'gyur/ /ser po thams cad gnod pa ste/ /'di ni bstan bcos nges pa yin/ /ser pos dpung ni gnon pa dang / /gru dang 'khrul 'khor glang po gnon/ /dkar po bsams pa tsam gyis ni/ /'chi ba med par slong bar 'gyur/ /sbrul chen brgya yis zin nas ni/ /'chi ba myur du slong bar 'gyur/ /dug gi brgyal bar gyur pa dag /gsal bar byas na zad par 'gyur/ /rims dang gdon dang brjed byed ni/ /lag pa mthong bas 'jigs par 'gyur/ /rgyan por khu tshur bcings nas ni/ /yid la rtag tu zlos byed na/ /ji srid khu tshur ma bkrol bar/ /rengs pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /dgra bo gal te lag na ni/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs 'phyar ba yang / /ji srid khu tshur ma bkrol bar/ /mtshon cha gtong bar mi nus so/ /yang na bya ba thams cad ni/ /ji bzhin nyid du sgrub par byed/

/'bras bu me tog 'dab ma dang / /so rtsi de bzhin zas rnams la/ /lus kyi sbyor ba dang po ste/ /de bzhin gnyis pa nus pa yin/ /gsum pa dag ni phyi yi nyid/ /bzhi pa yis ni dmigs pa med/ /sngags kyi rgyal po 'grub par 'gyur/ /sa gzhi shing dang bcas pa dang / /rgya mtsho skye rags btags pa yang / /de la nges par 'grub pa ni/ /'gyur bar 'di ni the tshom med/ /khams gsum rgyu dang mi rgyu ba/ /smod 'debs phan 'dogs nus pa yin/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa las nye ba'i snying po'i las bsgrub pa'i cho ga'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa'o// //de nas pho nya rnyed na ni/ /yi ge bdun par ldan bsgrub pa/ /gang du las ni yang dag rtsom/ /de yi las ni myur 'grub bshad/ /de bzhin du ni yi ge bdun/ /lag pa'i dbus su rnam par dgod/ /rnal 'byor ma ni drug yang dag /rtsibs drug 'khor lo yang dag gnas/ /g.yon pa'i 'khor lo bskul dang gnas/ /gang gi gzugs 'dzin bsams nas ni/ /kha nas gsang sngags rgyal po zlos/ /gang la lag pa de bstan na/ /des ni nges par 'gugs par 'gyur/ /tsandan dmar po'i rdul dang ni/ /skye tshe de bzhin lan tshwa dang / /bsgrub par bya ba'i rkang rjes sa/ /gcig tu bsdus nas btag par bya/ /lag pa gnyis kyis mnyes nas ni/ /rnal 'byor ma yi sbyin sreg bya/ /mtshan mo sme sha can me'am/ /dur khrod me la phye ma bsreg /bsgrub par bya la mngon bsres te/ /sbyong ba 'di ni brtsam par bya/ /ji srid brgya yi bar du bzlas/ /de ni nges par 'gugs par 'gyur/ /sa yi bdag po bdag nyid dang / /nor yang dbang du 'gyur ba yin/ /sbyor ba 'di ni 'grub par bskyed/ /gzhan dag tu ni nga mi smra/ /rdul de nyid ni blangs nas su/ /lcags phye dang ni rnam par bsre/ /dur khrod ras la btums nas ni/ /lan bdun bzlas nas bzhi mdo ru/ /sor brgyad tsam du bkod nas ni/ /dgra yi ming dang bcas par ni/

/gang gi ming smos sbas 'gyur ba/ /de ni myur du gnon par 'gyur/ /phye ma nyid ni blangs nas ni/ /'bad de ba yi 'o ma dang / /der ni slar yang gsos gyur na/ /'grub pa nyid du the tshom med/ /phye ma de ni blangs nas ni/ /myos byed lnga dang ldan pas su/ /de ni dur khrod ras kyis bcings/ /dgra yi ming yang bcing bar bya/ /bzlas brjod lan brgya byas nas ni/ /dur khrod du ni myur sbas na/ /'phral du smyo ba nyid du 'gyur/ /bton pa nyid kyis thar par 'gyur/ /bton nas gos dang phral nas ni/ /'bad de ba yi 'o ma dang / /slar yang gso bar byed pa dang / /'grub par 'di la the tshom med/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa las rnal 'byor ma drug dang yi ge bdun gyi las kyi cho ga'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //de nas las kyi rab mchog ni/ /ngag gi dngos grub sgrub byed pa'o/ /ka ra bī ra'i me tog dmar/ /brgya rtsa brgyad ni blangs nas su/ /'dab de ba yi 'o mas bkru/ /bzlas brjod brgya dang bya ba yin/ /lan bdun bzlas pa'i me tog gis/ /liṅga'i spyi bor bsnun par bya/ /de ltar shin tu mnyam bzhag pas/ /nyi ma bdun du bya ba yin/ /de ltar nyin zhag bcu gcig la/ /me tog dag ni blangs nas su/ /chu bo chen por song nas ni/ /re re nas ni chu la dor/ /de nas thams cad rim bzhin du/ /lan re bzlas nas rab tu sbyar/ /chu bor me tog mtha' mar ni/ /rgyun las bzlog te rab 'bab na/ /chu dang bcas par blangs nas ni/ /sos ma reg par de 'thungs na/ /gsang ba'i rgyud las 'byung ba yi/ /sgrub po'i tshig ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas skye gnas brgya bcings la/ /sngags pas bsgrub byar mngon phyogs na/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas nas ni/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i lto bar gnas/ /de nas yid ni gnas bzhin du/ /blo ldan thun gsum mthe chung bskyod/ /bram ze gsod pa'ang zhag bdun gyis/ /brgya byin yang ni nges par 'gugs/

/tsan dan dmar po'i rdul las ni/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i gzugs byas la/ /tsha ba gsum gyis lus la bsku/ /spra tshil gyis kyang rab tu byug /sgrub pa po yi gsang gnas su/ /zangs ma'i khab kyis phug nas su/ /seng ldeng mdag me du med la/ /lan brgya bzlas te sros nas su/ /rgyal po blon bcas mdun na 'don/ /chung ma 'khor dang bcas par ni/ /myur du 'gugs par byed pa yin/ /yi mi bdag po 'khor bcas ni/ /gro ga'i 'dab mar bris pa'am/ /dur khrod ras la sen rtsi dang / /ghi haṃ dag gis bris nas ni/ /ming dang spel nas gang la ni/ /mngon par phyogs te brgya bzlas nas/ /dur khrod me la de gdungs na/ /dur khrod me de 'grub phyir bshad/ /ji srid spra tshil ma zhu bar/ /bsros par gyur na rgyal po ni/ /'khor los bsgyur dang bcas pa yang / /nges par 'gugs par 'gyur ba yin/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i rkang rjes sa/ /tsan dan dmar po nyid dang ni/ /dur khrod thal bar bsregs pa rnams/ /sgrub pa po yis gcig bsdus la/ /seng ldeng me ni du med la/ /rdul de lag pa gnyis kyis ni/ /mnyes la sbyin sreg byas nas ni/ /ji srid thams cad bsregs pas 'grub/ /rdul de blangs nas ma yengs par/ /dbugs mi 'byin par sbas nas ni/ /brgyal zhing sems dang bral 'dra la/ /rmongs shing sems ni nyon mongs la/ /rlung gi shugs kyis 'ongs nas ni/ /sgrub pa po yi steng du ltung / /phyugs sam yang na pho nya mo/ /de nas las kyi pho nya mor/ /bya ba 'di ni 'dzin par 'gyur/ /ka ra bī ra'i lcug ma ni/ /rlan bcas dpung pa'i tshad mnyam blangs/ /'bar gyur ro bsregs me la dor/ /ji srid de ni ma tshig bar/ /myur du song ste de blangs nas/ /rig pa lan bdun bzlas nas ni/ /gang zhig bzlas te bskor na ni/ /de ni de yi skad cig la/ /bud med dang ni skyes pa dag /rlung gi shugs kyis 'ong bar 'gyur/ /ka ra bī ra'i me tog dmar/

/brgya bzlas rgyal gyi sbyor ba las/ /sgrub pos ghi haṃ gos byugs la/ /me tog chu la gnas pa dag /chu bo chen por zhugs nas ni/ /lte ba nub pa'i bar du ni/ /lag pa'i sbyor bas dbus gnas la/ /rig pa stong du bzlas nas ni/ /lag pa gnyis kyis phyer brlags te/ /chu dang bcas pa btung bar bya/ /de nas sgrub pa po de yis/ /tshig gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /rgyal po'am rgyal po'i chung ma ni/ /yid kyis nges par 'gugs par 'gyur/ /lhar bcas lha min mi rnams ni/ /myur du dbang du byed par 'gyur/ /khros pas tshig gis gsod par 'gyur/ /dbye dang bskrad pa nyid kyang byed/ /sgrub pa po yi tshig nyid kyis/ /tshar gcod pa nyid byed par 'gyur/ /tshig tsam gyis ni chu bo dang / /shing rta 'khrul 'khor rgya mtsho dang / /glang po rta dang de bzhin sprin/ /skyes bu'am yang na bya ba gnon/ /yid la gang dang gang 'dod pa/ /tshig gis thams cad byed par 'gyur/ /de nas gzhan gyi las bshad pa/ /dpa' bo chen po rang nyid gsum/ /dgug pa yi ni sbyor ba dag /bud med thams cad rmongs byed pa/ /ka ra bī ra'i me tog ni/ /dmar po yang dag blangs nas su/ /rig pa lan bdun bzlas pa dag /skye gnas dbus su gzhug par bya/ /me tog de ni kha sbyar byas/ /gsang ba'i gnas su nges par sbyar/ /gnyis med ye shes rnal 'byor ldan/ /sngags pas brgya phrag gcig tu bzlas/ /skye gnas dbus nas me tog de/ /sgrub pa po yis gcig blangs nas/ /me tog gis ni gang bsnun pa/ /de yi mod la dbang du 'gyur/ /brgyal zhing sems dang bral ba dang / /yan lag tshigs kun gzhan dbang ste/ /yid ches sems can 'jug pa ru/ /skad cig gis ni dbang du byed/ /'di ni mngon du 'grub pa ste/ /don yod dbang du byed pa yin/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa las rnal 'byor ma drug gi tshig gi dngos grub dang dgug pa'i cho ga'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa'o//

//de nas yi ge ha lnga ni/ /las rnams thams cad 'grub byed pa/ /gang zhig shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /myur du dngos grub thob par bshad/ /hāe hāo hūm̐ haṃ haḥ yi ge ha ni lnga po dang / /lag pa mnyes pas bskul tshig bcas/ /kha nas kyang ni khrag 'dzag cing / /dgra bo de yi mod la 'chi/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i thod gnas pa/ /srin lag khrag gis mnye bar bya/ /ji srid skams kyi bar du ste/ /des ni bsgrub bya rnam par 'jig /gal te khro ba 'bar ba dang / /mig dmar gyur pas bzlas na ni/ /dpung tshogs bzhon par byas pa yi/ /rgyal po myur du brlag par byed/ /byi la dang ni ne'u le dang / /khyi khwa wa dang chu skyar dang / /mkha' 'gro ma la gtor bsreg bya/ /'di dag myur du 'grub yin pa/ /rgyud 'di la ni the tshom med/ /ri bong la sogs spu las ni/ /srad bu byas te lan stong bzlas/ /gang gi mgul du bcings gyur pa/ /de ni de dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /lag pa bzlas brjod stong bya ste/ /ka ra bī ra'i me tog dang / /yi ge re res mngon bzlas te/ /sbrum ma la ni reg gyur na/ /mngal ni rnam par 'pho 'gyur te/ /btang na thar bar 'gyur ba yin/ /gang la sdigs mdzub byas te 'chi/ /slar yang 'tsho bar byed pa yin/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa las yi ge ha lnga'i las kyi cho ga'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa drug pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /mkha' 'gro kun gyi snying po ste/ /'di ni brjod pa tsam gyis kyang / /dngos grub thams cad bskyed byed yin/ /de la mkha' 'gro ma'i rig pa chen pos bzlas na/ rigs thams cad dbang du byed par 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu bzlas brjod byas pas ni dpal chen po bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /mi rus kyi rgyu las phur bu sor drug pa byas la/ brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bzlas nas gang gi sgor sbas pa de'i rigs rgyud rnams gcod par 'gyur ro/ /zhing dang ra ba dang ma he dang glang po che dang /

rta'i gnas su brkos te sbas na/ thams cad brlag par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal po 'am rgyal po'i blon po dbang du bya bar 'dod na/ rgyal po'i sgor sa las byas pa'i gzugs brnyan sor brgyad par byas la/ mkhas pas bzhag nas nyin zhag dang po la ma du lung ka'i 'bras bu dang me tog bsregs te/ sbyin sreg brgya stong byas na de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /sngags 'di nyid kyis dgug pa dang / gnon pa dang / rmongs pa dang / skem pa dang / rmugs pa dang / tshig 'phrog pa dang / long bar byed pa dang / slar gtong bar byed do/ /de nas skyes pa bud med du bya bar 'dod na/ ro'i me tog dang / ka ka an tri ka'i 'bras bu dang / bkres pa'i sen mo dang / rkang pa'i 'og gi lpags pa cha mnyam par byas la/ ri bong gi khrag dang btags te/ ri lu bcu gcig byas la grib ma la bskam mo/ /de bzhin du zhag bzang po la lag pa la bcings te/ nyi ma bcu gnyis pa la gang gi phye ma mgo la bzhag pa de bud med du 'gyur ro/ /de nas skyes pa khyir bya bar 'dod na/ rgya lcags ne'u le'i spyi bor bzhag la/ mtshan mo bdun gyi bar du brgya stong bzlas pas nyin zhag brgyad pa la gur gum dang mnyam par byas te/ lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la phye ma'i sbyin sreg byas na/ gang gi spyi bor bzhag pa de khyir 'gyur ro/ /slar gso ba ni mtshan mo'i dus su mkha' 'gro ma rnams la mchod pa chen po byas te/ gtor ma byin na de'i 'og tu rnal mar 'gyur ro/ /rdzas rdzas ma yin par 'dod na/ gser shing gi 'bras bus sbyin bsreg brgya byas na/ rdzas rdzas ma yin par 'gyur ro/ /a ru ra'i sbyin sreg byas na rnal mar 'gyur ro/ /de nas glo bur ba rnams bskyed par 'dod na/ bya chen po'i gnas kyi sbyin sreg byas na/ zhag bdun gyi glo bur ba 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /slar bzlog pa ni 'bras phub kyi sbyin sreg byas na zhi bar 'gyur ro/

/byi la'i spu zla ba gzas zin pa'i tshe/ bsdus nas gang gi ming nas brjod nas sbyin sreg byas pa de'i thal ba blangs te/ mgo bor byin na byi lar 'gyur ro/ /slar bzlog na rnal mar 'gyur ro/ /bya rog gi rgyus pa las sred bu byas la/ brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bzlas te/ gang gi mgul du bcings pa de khwar 'gyur ro/ /sems can gang la gang gi rgyus pa srad bu blangs la mngon par bzlas te/ bcings pa de de dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du khwa dang / thi ba dang / rma bya dang / chu skyar dang / 'ug pa dang / khra dang / bya rgod kyi gzugs 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /ba lang gi spu las srad bu byas la/ lan brgyad brgya bzlas brjod byas te mgul du bcings na ba lang du 'gyur ro/ /gang dang gang rkang pa bzhi pa de'i srad bu byas la/ mngon par bsngags pas mgul du btags na de dang de'i gzugs su 'gyur ro/ /bkrol na thar par 'gyur ro/ /'bru la bzlas la nor gyi bdag po'i khyim du bcug na/ lhag mas bdag nyid dbang bskur na/ mtshan mo bdun gyis 'bru thams cad 'gugs par 'gyur ro/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i sngags kyi las thams cad pa'i cho ga'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa bdun pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /mkha' 'gro kun gyi bde ba'i mchog /snying po rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /'dod pa'i las kun sgrub pa po/ /gang zhig dran pa tsam gyis ni/ /'jig rten gsum po g.yo byed cing / /rjes su dran pa tsam gyis kyang / /yang dag dngos grub rim gyis gter/ /hā swā ṭapha hūm̐ hum̐ ye nirṇab dzrab ye nī ki ḍā ddha bu rbas oṃ/ sngags 'di bzlas pas 'grub pa ste/ /las rnams kun byed dge ba yin/ /mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma rnams dang / /khaṇḍa ro hā lā ma sogs/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni thams cad kyi/ /sngags ni 'di nyid yin par bshad/ /sa 'og yang na mtho ris sam/

/de bzhin mi yul dag tu yang / /las ni gang dag yod pa rnams/ /klags pas de dag thams cad 'grub/ /'di las shin tu mchog gyur gang / /'jig rten gsum na ci yang med/ /gang phyir 'di ni bla med pa/ /las rnams thams cad sgrub byed yin/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni kun gyi gnas/ /mdo bshad rgyas par ma yin no/ /me tog 'bras bu sna tshogs kyi/ /ri bo bzang po bri bar bya/ /de yi steng du rtag bsgom pa/ /mkha' 'gro de bzhin lā ma dang / /khaṇḍa ro hā rnal 'byor ma/ /dpa' bo rnams kyi dpa' bo mchog /ha ha he he zhes bya ba/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi yi/ /mkha' 'gro'i dra ba bde mchog yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam snang mdzad/ /de bzhin pad ma gar dbang dang / /shrī he ru ka nyid dang ni/ /mkha' snying dang ni rta mgrin nyid/ /rin chen rdo rje stobs po che/ /mig mi bzang dang 'jigs byed dang / /rdo rje bzang dang rab bzang dang / /rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dpa' chen po/ /de bzhin rdo rje ral pa can/ /myu gu can dang rdo rje'i lus/ /rdo rje'i 'od ni nyid dag dang / /'od dpag med dang lha yi sgra/ /de bzhin mche ba rnam gtsigs dang / /keng rus rkeng rus chen po dang / /thod pa'i dum bu la sogs pa/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi yis/ /'gro ba 'di dag thams cad khyab/ /dpa' bo rnams dang mkha' 'gro nyid/ /rnal 'byor ma ni rab gtum sogs/ /las rnams kun la sgrub pa pos/ /'khor lor zhugs par blta bar bya/ /grub 'dod shin tu mnyam bzhag pas/ /'khor lo'i bdag nyid rtag tu bsgom/ /sngar bshad pa yi cho ga yis/ /mkha' 'gro dra bar bde mchog mchod/ /'khor lo chen po grub kun gnas/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bye ba dang / /dpa' bo bye bas rab tu gsungs/ /mkha' gro ma ni re re yi/ /'khor ni bye ba dag tu 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor ma ni mkha' 'gro nyid/ /gzugs can ma dang dum skyes ma/ /de bzhin lā ma la sogs ni/ /dngos grub kun byed dge ba yin/

/dpal 'khor lo sdom pa las dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma'i gnas kyi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /phyugs las de bzhin cho ga ste/ /gang zhig shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /myur du dngos grub thob 'gyur ba'o/ /sa lu btags pa sngags pa yis/ /phyugs kyi gzugs byas rim ji bzhin/ /rus sbal rnga mo phag dang wa/ /khwa dang 'ug pa bya rgod dang / /khrung khrung khra dang sa ra sa/ /de rnams las ni bshad bya ste/ /de yi mtshan nyid bstan par bya/ /skye ba gcig dang skye ba gnyis/ /gsum dang bzhi dang lnga nyid ste/ /skye ba drug dang bdun du yang / /skye ba brgyud par gdon mi za/ /gang gi kha yi dri zhim zhing / /mig mi 'dzum par rnam par blta/ /bden par smra zhing mthong na dga'/ /rtag tu dam chos dga' 'gyur zhing / /rang gi skye ba shes pa dang / /lus kyi dri ni rtag tu zhim/ /mtshan nyid 'di dang ldan pa ni/ /skye ba bdun du 'byung ba yin/ /de ni zos pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha yi gzugs ni 'dzin par 'gyur/ /bsnams pa'am reg pa tsam gyis ni/ /gang zhig thig le byas pa de/ /mod la 'grub par 'gyur ba ste/ /'di ni rang dga'i gzugs 'chang 'gyur/ /de yi snying kha'i ro tsa na/ /mkhas pa yis ni blangs nas ni/ /snying po'i sngags ni bzlas nas su/ /de yi thig le bya ba yin/ /sems can gang dang gang gi ni/ /gzugs su byed par 'dod pa na/ /de dang de yi gzugs su ni/ /thig les 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /mkhas pas shing lo'i khu ba ni/ /ro tsa na bcas blangs nas su/ /dpral bar thig le byas nas ni/ /de gzugs 'dzin par the tshom med/ /phyugs nyid kyi ni ba spu dag /lag pa'am spyi bor bcing bar bya/ /de yi yan lag lnga ldan zhing / /de yi spu dang rnam bsres la/ /lag pa spyi bor bcings nas ni/ /de yi gzugs 'gyur the tshom med/ /rnal 'byor pa ni bsgoms shing bzlos/

/mi rnams nus pa ldan yin yang / /dka' zhing sdig la mngon dga' rnams/ /dngos grub lam ni 'gog pa yin/ /glang po rta dang bong bu dang / /rus sbal rnga mo phag dang wa/ /khwa dang 'ug pa bya rgod dang / /khrung khrung khra dang sa ra sa/ /gzugs bzang ba dang gzugs ngan pa/ /lha yi gzugs su de 'gyur ro/ /rnal 'byor dpa' chen rang dga'i gzugs/ /skye 'gyur de ni tho tshom med/ /de las shin tu mchog gyur pa/ /'jig rten gsum na yod ma yin/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa las skye ba bdun du bsgrub par bya ba'i gzugs yongs su brje ba'i cho ga'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa dgu pa'o// //de nas sbyin sreg cho ga ni/ /nges par dbang du byed 'gyur ba/ /gang zhig shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /myur du dngos grub thob 'gyur bshad/ /go maṃ sa dang myos byed bsre/ /lag pa g.yon pas sbyin sreg bya/ /sangs rgyas kyang ni dbang 'gyur na/ /phran tshegs mi ni smos ci dgos/ /skyug pa so shing dor ba dang / /de bzhin rang gi lus mnyes pa/ /ming ni myos byed btags bsres pas/ /khams gsum dag ni dbang du 'gyur/ /zla mtshan gyi ni khrag dang ni/ /zos nas zlos pa'i zas dag dang / /mi yi skra dang ldan pa yis/ /mod la 'gugs par 'gyur ba yin/ /rang gi lus byung skyugs pa dang / /mkhas pas rang gi skra dang ni/ /nim pa'i shing la rab sbyar na/ /mod la dbye bar 'gyur ba yin/ /rab mnyam bzhag pas dha du'i mer/ /khwa yi gshog pas nyungs mar la/ /bsreg pa'i sbyin sreg byas gyur na/ /'phral du 'chi ba'am skrod par 'gyur/ /gnyid log ma log langs pa'am/ /zas la spyod sogs me thun nam/ /sngags pas rtag tu zlos byed de/ /de la bdud ni yod ma yin/ /lce spyang gi ni sreg blugs bya/ /yang dag sbyin sreg byed pa'i mi/ /de yi zla ba gsum rjes la/ /rigs kyi dbul ba 'jig par 'gyur/ /sha chen dag gis la la zhig /myos byed ldan pa sbyin sreg byed/

/brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bar du ni/ /sgrub pa po ni thun gsum du/ /ma lus sa rnams spyod pa ni/ /zla ba drug gis dbang du 'gyur/ /dges par gyur na mkha' 'gro ma/ /rgyal srid ster bar gdon mi za/ /lha rnams thams cad bsgoms nas ni/ /thun gnyis bar du sbyin sreg bya/ /rang gi lus ni de nyid kyis/ /mkha' la spyod pa nyid thob 'gyur/ /go ma spu dang myos byed kyis/ /sbyin sreg phyi nang bya ba byas/ /de yi lag tu myur 'grub ste/ /dngos grub thams cad du 'gyur ba/ /sngags kyi bzlas brjod mtshan mo bzlas/ /yul 'khor gcig ni 'jig par byed/ /de ltar nyin re byas nas ni/ /rgyal po nyid du de byed 'gyur/ /'di las rab mchog gzhan dag ni/ /'jig rten gsum na yod ma yin/ /rnal 'byor chen po rang dgar 'chi/ /sna tshogs gzugs ni 'dzin cing rol/ /bil ba de bzhin pa la sha/ /u dum bā ra nyid dag ni/ /sbyin sreg 'bum byas myur du ni/ /nor gyi bdag po chen por 'gyur/ /go maṃ sa dang myos byed bsre/ /rgyal srid 'dod cing sbyin sreg byed/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mnyes byas na/ /dbul po nyid du ga la 'gyur/ /go ma spu ni bsregs pa'i rgyus/ /ci bde ba ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /go ma spu yi sbyin bsreg gis/ /myur du nor bdag mnyam par 'gyur/ /brtul shugs gtsang sbra med na yang / /gnang bas dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /lhag pa'i tshe 'gyur gu sman dha/ /mud ga mā sha tsa na ka /sbrang rtsi'i rtsigs ma ske tshe dang / /ta ma la yi 'dab blangs te/ /gang zhig kha ni 'ching bya ba/ /rnal 'byor ci 'dod byung ba yis/ /gang du dga' ba der 'gyur ro/ /de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /gnas la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /he ru ka dpal sku'i yan lag /kun tu brtan g.yo'i bdag nyid can/ /gnas ni rab tu dga' ba'i sa/ /de bzhin nye gnas dri ma med/ /zhing ni 'od byed shes par bya/

/nye ba'i zhing ni 'od 'phro ba/ /tshan dho ha ni mngon gyur yin/ /u pa tshan dho sbyang dka' ba/ /'du ba ring du song ba yin/ /nye ba'i 'du ba mi g.yo ba/ /dur khrod legs pa'i blo gros yin/ /nye ba'i dur khrod chos kyi sprin/ /shrī he ru ka'i yul du spyod/ /'di ni nang gi bdag nyid sa/ /pha rol phyin bcu'i sa rnams ni/ /rnal 'byor ma yi brda yi skad/ /mtho ris sa steng sa 'og tu/ /dpa' bo yan lag brtan g.yo'i bdag /bu la sogs pa gang bstan pa/ /phyi nang bdag nyid can du gnas/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal po che/ /'dod pa kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /kun tu phyag dang zhabs ldan pa/ /kun tu mig dang mgo bo'i zhal/ /kun tu thos ldan 'jigs rten na/ /thams cad g.yogs par rnam par bzhugs/ /de bas dngos grub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bsam gtan ldan pa'i sems kyis te/ /sgrub pa po la phan pa'i phyir/ /gsang ba'i de nyid gsungs pa yin/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa las dbang gi sbyin sreg dang gnas la sogs pa'i bstan pa'i cho ga'i le'u ste lnga bcu pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /man ngag shin tu rnyed dka' ste/ /dpa' bo brda yi skad du ni/ /nga yis rgyud du sbas pa yin/ /gos dang phyag rgya lnga la sogs/ /shes rab yan lag phur bu dra/ /ā li kā li zhes brjod pa/ /rgyu sogs stong pa sngon 'gro ba/ /'jug pa sgra la sogs pa nas/ /ji srid bsdus pa'i sbyor ldan zhing / /bdud rtsi tshim byed mya ngan 'das/ /lag pa'i mchod pa dbang bskur ba/ /go cha chen po yang dag bsrung / /sngags rnams kun gyi mchod pa yin/ /de ltar de nyid bcu bzhi ni/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bshad pa yin/ /mi mchog gang zhig kun spyod pa/ /sdig pa thams cad rnam dag bdag /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa thob cing / /skye dang skye gnas bde gshegs kyi/ /rigs skyes chos ldan rgyal por 'gyur/ /ji srid mngon bsags sdig pa yi/

/bag chags kun zad mtshan nyid yin/ /gang zhig 'di ni rtag bsgom pa/ /sa la 'dod pa kun dbang phyug /dper na mar gyis gang ba'i snod/ /me yi dbus su bzhag na ni/ /mar gsar zhu zhing zhu 'gyur zhing / /snod kyi dri ma dag par 'gyur/ /de bzhin shrī ni he ru ka'i/ /mtshan gyis sdig pa 'jig par 'gyur/ /bsam gtan sems dpa' tsam gyis sam/ /klong cing 'don dang bris pa yis/ /mtho ris longs spyod thob 'gyur ba'am/ /yang na 'khor lo bsgyur ba thob/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams 'pho ba'i tshe/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs mkha' 'gro/ /lag na me tog sna tshogs thogs/ /rgyal mtshan ba dan sna tshogs dang / /rol mo'i sgra ni sna tshogs dang / /sna tshogs glu yi mchod pas mchod/ /'chi zhes bya ba'i rnam rtog 'di/ /mkha' la 'gro ba'i gnas su khyer/ /de 'dra'i dpal chen rnal 'byor ma/ /sa steng na ni rnyed par dka'/ /dpal ldan he ru ka rgyud chen/ /gang gis shes nas ma dad pa/ /dbul po sdug bsngal gyis gdungs pa/ /de la rtag tu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mgul rgyan gdu bu dpung rgyan dang / /rna cha tshangs pa'i skud pa dang / /do shal mgo bo'i phreng ba dang / /ske rags sil sil sgra sgrogs pa/ /ri steng sna tshogs pad ma yi/ /lte bar ā li kā li skyes/ /dbu ma'i bdag po rnam gnon cing / /rdo rje dril bus sku la 'khyud/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi phyed ldan pa'i/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs bskor/ /shrī he ru ka rgyal chen po/ /go 'phang mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /dpa' bo kun dang rnal 'byor ma'i/ /'khor bcas dbus su 'byor ldan pa/ /thams cad dges shing gnyis med 'gyur/ /'byin dang sdud par byed pa yin/ /mos pa du ma'i sems can la/ /spyod pa sna tshogs ston mdzad de/ /sna tshogs tshul gyi gdul bya la/ /thabs ni sna tshogs ston pa yin/ /zab mo'i chos ni ston pa la/ /gal te mos par ma gyur kyang / /smad pa dag tu mi bya ste/

/chos nyid bsam mi khyab dran bya/ /gang gis 'di bdag yul min pa/ /bdag gi chos nyid mi shes shing / /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de'i sras ni/ /bdag nyid chen po rnams kyis mkhyen/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni 'byung gyur tam/ /ma byung na yang rnam kun tu/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i chos nyid ni/ /'phel 'grib spangs pas gnas pa yin/ /de ltar rnam par bzhag nas kyang / /'jig rten pa kun yong mi smad/ /de yi 'gro ba bsam yas shing / /sangs rgyas rol pa bsam mi khyab/ /ji srid mdo bya spyod pa ni/ /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba nyid/ /sems can mos pas 'jug pa rnams/ /de dang de la dga' ba yin/ /dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po 'bum pa'i nang nas phyung ba dngos grub kyi cho ga shin tu rmad du byung ba bstan chos thams cad dpal he ru ka dpa' bo chen pos klags pas 'grub pa thams cad mkhyen pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa 'dod na grub pa'i mchog gi mchog dpal 'khor lo sdom pa zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa'o// //rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po padma ka ra warma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban dhe rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/ /slad kyi paṇḍi ta chen po su ma ti kirti dang / lo tsā ba mal ban dhe blo gros grags kyis zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 62 rdo rje 'chang / bde mchog nyung ngu / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 61
